scope: GTK3 parent, action data routing, deterministic binding teardown; no complete WBS29 gesture/visual parity claim

obligations.replacement: The legacy LayerTileView-specific include is replaced by the existing GimpImageEditor include: the new tile widget derives from GimpImageEditor and needs no action helper special case.
Legacy type-specific context lookup for action_data_get_gimp is replaced by native context/display routing. The new per-widget context retains the same owning Gimp.
The native GIMP_IS_IMAGE_EDITOR branch returns the per-widget context directly, without the extra property-get reference used by the legacy path. close() clears this parent context.

The native image-editor branch returns the editor image, including NULL, avoiding fallback to an unrelated global active image. Binding generation guards keep rows and parent image consistent during reentry.
Native action_data_get_display resolves the tile-local context. set_display binds a canvas display independently of the global context; multi-canvas assertions exercise both displays.

Legacy NewGClass/global class instance/private LayerTileView implementation is replaced by G_DEFINE_TYPE plus BindingStore Slot<Tiles>. The native GtkBox-derived GimpImageEditor parent supplies image/action context. destroy closes sources/connections/context/image before chaining. New guards reject post-destroy image connection and stale nested image binding.

Legacy GtkBox C instance/class layouts and C++ Interface::cast header are replaced by C-compatible GimpImageEditor instance/class layouts and a single current GType/C operation API. Internal TypeTraits maps to that GType. No compatibility promise for the removed C++ private interface is made.
